coast.prompt: Seamless stereo field recording at dawn on a sheltered medieval coast. Small salt waves draw over round stones and quietly retreat, a distant gull, airy open horizon. Even perspective, restful natural sound, no music.

river.prompt: Seamless close stereo recording of a lively clear woodland river winding around mossy stones, distinct little ripples travelling left and right over a deeper gentle current, occasional soft lapping. No birds or music.

woodland.prompt: Seamless late morning woodland ambience, canopy leaves moving overhead, scattered thrushes at different distances, earthy stillness between bird phrases, sheltered forest, no music and no voices.

night.prompt: Seamless nocturnal woodland at the edge of a mountain village. Gentle breeze through fir needles, sparse distant crickets and a single soft owl far off, restful low bed. No music.

quarry.prompt: Seamless open limestone quarry ambience. Wind in high rock walls, occasional distant muted stone tap with a natural short echo; long quiet gaps. No industrial motors, no speech, no music.

hearth.prompt: Seamless small domestic cooking hearth inside a timber cottage. Low log fire with tiny wooden ticks and ember crackles, intimate but very gentle; a quiet room around it. No speech or music.

interior.prompt: Seamless quiet medieval timber house interior. Soft air under a wooden door, very occasional house timber settling, soft distant wind muffled by walls. No footsteps, voices or music.

cellar.prompt: Seamless quiet cool stone cellar, damp air and distant single water drops with a short stone resonance, deep still room tone. Natural low sound; no music.

village.prompt: Seamless village lane in a hand-built medieval valley. Soft open air, sparrows in a gutter, distant woodwork, leaves stirring at the edges. No intelligible voices, traffic, music or loud isolated hits.

shorestep.prompt: One soft leather boot planting on damp pebbles beside a river. Close dry foley, crisp grains of stone under weight.

pet_cat.prompt: One friendly domestic cat gives a tiny chirrup then purrs warmly as a hand brushes its fur. Intimate natural foley only.

pet_dog.prompt: Friendly village hound greeting a hand with a happy soft huff and a little collar jingle, tail gently tapping wood, close natural foley, no barking attack.

sit.prompt: A traveller settles onto an old wooden bench. Brief cloth rustle, soft weight and a warm timber creak.

stir.prompt: A wooden spoon circles twice around a small iron stewpot, subtle wet stirring and one light rim tap. Close foley, no fire roar.

gather.prompt: One hand plucks a fresh herb from the earth. Leaves brush, stem snaps softly, a pinch of crumbly soil.

work.prompt: A small hand tool works a medieval wooden bench with a short scrape and two quiet wooden taps. Intimate dry foley.

loom.prompt: A hand loom in a cottage. One shuttle knocks through taut threads, followed by a short wooden heddle clack and yarn sliding.

read.prompt: One thick dry parchment leaf gently turned in a leatherbound book, soft fibrous flutter with a quiet settle.

dress.prompt: Close gentle leatherworking movement: leather folds, a cutting tool draws briefly and an unrolled hide settles on soft earth.

bow_draw.prompt: One taut wooden longbow slowly drawn, supple wood creak and tight string tension, close textured foley, then silence.

bow_release.prompt: Single medieval longbow string snaps forward with a clean woody twang and a short feathered swish away. Crisp isolated game foley.

arrow_ground.prompt: A single wooden arrow hits soft damp earth with a low dull thup and a small shaft vibration. Isolated outdoor foley.

arrow_flesh.prompt: A blunt, muffled impact on heavy leather, with a soft shaft tremor. Close understated game impact sound.

skinning_complete.prompt: A folded piece of thick leather settles into a cloth satchel, soft rustle and a small buckle tap.

door.prompt: A latch lifts and a cottage door turns on an old iron hinge, a soft solid foot-level thud. One close gentle wood sound.

blade.prompt: A short blade sweeps through the air in a single swift arc, light leather grip movement and clean airy edge. Dry foley only.

water_enter.prompt: One boot steps from a bank into a clear shallow river, low plop and delicate water droplets in the foreground.

water_exit.prompt: One wet leather boot pulls free of a shallow stream and lands on sand, soft splash with a brief trickle.

water_wade.prompt: One soft knee-deep wading step in a small river, a rounded watery swish and ripples, isolated, no river bed.

water_swim.prompt: A single smooth swimming stroke across open river water, palm moves a sheet of water with small splashes. Isolated close foley.

cargo.wood.prompt: One solid hollow timber crate set down on an oak floor in a medieval workshop. Immediate low woody knock, subtle rattle of slats, short dry decay. Isolated game Foley with an immediate attack. No speech, music or background.

cargo.stone.prompt: A small fist sized river stone drops onto hard stone, one crisp mineral contact followed by one tiny tick, close and dry. Isolated game Foley with an immediate attack. No speech, music or background.

cargo.pottery.prompt: A thick empty glazed earthenware jug set firmly on a wooden tabletop. One bright resonant ceramic clink, followed by a tiny settling tick. Intact vessel. Isolated game Foley with an immediate attack. No speech, music or background.

cargo.metal.prompt: One light iron tool taps a rough stone floor. Brief textured metallic clank and a soft short ring. Isolated game Foley with an immediate attack. No speech, music or background.

cargo.cloth.prompt: A heavy grain sack drops on an indoor timber floor. Short low muffled thump with a little movement of grain and coarse cloth. Isolated game Foley with an immediate attack. No speech, music or background.

cargo.leaves.prompt: A hand brushes a branch full of small green leaves. A quick close rustle tapering to silence. Quiet woodland foley. Isolated game Foley with an immediate attack. No speech, music or background.
